```python
def check_nesting(text, limit=64):
    depth = 0
    for match in _STRING_OR_BRACKET.finditer(text):
        token = match.group(0)
        first = token[0]
        if first == '"':
            continue
        if first in '{[':
            depth += 1
            if depth > limit: raise Invalid('nesting')
        else:
            depth -= 1
            if depth < 0: raise Invalid('nesting')
    if depth != 0: raise Invalid('nesting')
```
